cards.question: What are the two sublayers of the Data-Link Layer under IEEE 802?
cards.answer:
1. Logical Link Control (LLC)
2. Media Access Control (MAC)

cards.question: What is the broadcast MAC address representation?
cards.answer: Forty-eight 1s, written in hex as FF:FF:FF:FF:FF:FF

questions.question: Which sublayer handles flow control under IEEE 802?
questions.explanation: LLC handles flow control and framing (p.116).

data.title: AI Video Explainer: Computer Networks & Protocols

scenes.title: 1. Core Foundations & Scope
scenes.narration: Welcome to this StudyVault video breakdown on Computer Networks & Protocols. In this opening module, we establish the core theoretical foundation, framing requirements, and operational context defined in your documents.
keyPoints: Foundational design principles and layer separation
subtitles: Welcome to the AI Lecture Overview.

scenes.title: 2. Protocol Stack & Sublayer Dynamics
scenes.narration: Moving into the protocol architecture. The documents emphasize strict demarcation between upper logical control and physical media transmission, ensuring resilient framing and deterministic packet dispatch.
subtitles: LLC handles multiplexing and flow control.
MAC resolves media access and CRC verification.

scenes.title: 3. Collision Resolution & Addressing
scenes.narration: Next, let's explore collision management and address resolution. When packets traverse shared segments, carrier sense multiple access with collision detection enforces random exponential backoff intervals to prevent network congestion.
keyPoints: 48-bit global MAC addressing and broadcast domains
subtitles: Carrier Sense Multiple Access mechanism active.
Unicast, multicast, and broadcast address resolution.

scenes.title: 4. Synthesis & Exam Takeaways
scenes.narration: In summary, mastering these core principles guarantees complete command over your exams and technical reviews. Focus on the relationship between frames, MAC address structures, and physical medium boundaries.
keyPoints: Key formulas, timeouts, and framing headers
subtitles: Mastering key formulas and header bytes.
